entries.name: api-caller
entries.description: Call any REST API dynamically. Make GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests to any endpoint with custom headers and JSON body.

entries.name: calculator
entries.description: Evaluate mathematical expressions and unit conversions. Handles arithmetic, percentages, exponents, and common unit conversions (temperature, distance, weight). No external dependencies.

entries.name: create-custom-grader
entries.description: Use when converting an existing benchmark, rubric, verifier, task YAML/JSON, or domain check into SkillEvaluator BYOG/BYOT custom evaluation.

entries.name: skillevaluator
entries.description: Run and interpret SkillEvaluator for agent skills. Use for any skill benchmark or eval - validating or scoring a SKILL.md, writing evals.json test cases or evals config, explaining benchmark reports, verdicts and exit codes, or gating skills in CI.

entries.name: task-list
entries.description: Required for 4+ step requests; add tasks at start and update status after each step.

entries.name: text-analyzer
entries.description: Analyze text content and produce statistics including word count, line count, character count, sentence count, average word length, and most frequent words. Use when asked to analyze, count, or summarize a text or a text file (inline text or a file path such as input.txt), or when a request names text-analyzer.
